items.title: Optio acquires Norwegian underwriting business SAFE Forsikring
items.summary: London-based specialty MGA Optio Group has expanded its Nordic operations and aquaculture capabilities by acquiring Norwegian underwriting business SAFE Forsikring.

items.title: EQ Investors and Nordea launch sustainable multi-asset funds
items.summary: EQ Investors and Nordea Asset Management have partnered to introduce two sustainable multi-asset funds with a 0.35% ongoing charge figure.

items.title: Aspect MGA uses AI linguistic model to analyse broker submissions
items.summary: Aspect MGA is using a forensic linguistic AI model to assess commercial property submission text and inform underwriting decisions.

items.title: Tatton CEO Hogarth highlights consolidator risks during half-year results
items.summary: Tatton Asset Management founder and chief executive Paul Hogarth criticised single-proposition wealth consolidators while presenting the firm's half-year financial results.

items.title: Precautionary product withdrawals may not trigger recall insurance cover
items.summary: Insurers warn that product withdrawals made without a formal regulatory recall instruction can lead to disputed claims under liability policies.

items.title: Samsung Fire & Marine to increase Canopius stake to 80.6%
items.summary: Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance has agreed to acquire a further stake in specialty re/insurer Canopius Group, raising its total ownership to 80.6%.
